mapper.select: SELECT r.body, r.version, r.updated_at, u.display_name AS updated_by_display_name FROM event_retrospectives r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.updated_by WHERE r.space_id = #{spaceId} AND r.event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_retrospectives (event_id, space_id, body, version, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{spaceId}, #{body}, 1, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
